Authorization

Get Access Token

This API allows you to generate the access token.

Authorizations:
None
Request Body schema: application/json
required
grant_type
required
string
Value: "client_credentials"

The grant type to be used.

client_id
required
string

The client id specific to your client application.

client_secret
required
string

The client secret specific to you client application.

scope
string
Default: "read"
Enum: "read" "write" "everything"

Use scope to limit access token privileges.

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/identity/oauth/token
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/identity/oauth/token

Audience

Everything about Audience

Get audiences

This API allows you to retrieve a list of all audiences for the tenant.

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
query Parameters
pageSize
integer
Default: 10

The number of audiences to return per page.

pageToken
string

Should be what is returned as nextPageToken from a previous page request if passed.

includeTotal
boolean
Default: false

Whether to include the total number of users in the response. To include set it to true

searchTerm
string
Example: searchTerm=marketing

Search term to filter audiences by name

categoryId
string
Example: categoryId=4ba58d96-9ac2-4820-88ef-28aa4555500d

Audience category ID to filter by.

This is valid for only ABAC enabled tenants. For non-ABAC tenants, if you pass anything here it will throw error.

parentId
string
Example: parentId=7ca58d96-8ac2-4820-88eu-28aa4555500e

Parent audience ID to filter by.

This is valid for only ABAC enabled tenants. For non-ABAC tenants, if you pass anything here it will throw error.

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/identity/audiences
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/identity/audiences

Create a new audience

This API allows you to create a new audience

Note:

parentId, categoryId, or categoryName are only supported for tenants where ABAC is enabled

Please login in to simpplr App to find IDs of segment, user, ad group, okta group, google group

Example 1: Segment with IS_NOT operator

  "name": "Audience with segment exclusion",
  "type": "mixed",
  "rule": {
    "AND": [
      {
        "AND": [
          {
            "values": [
              {
                "value": "49a8828d-16d9-4265-a82e-063fc1f10afe"
              }
            ],
            "attribute": "segmentId",
            "operator": "IS_NOT",
            "fieldType": "segment"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "sourceType": "app_managed",
  "parentId":"39437d92-9be0-4a25-8543-55bdab74df4e"
} ```

**Example 2: User ID with IS operator and First Name/Last Name with CONTAINS/STARTS_WITH**
``` {
  "name": "Audience with user ID and name filters",
  "type": "mixed",
  "rule": {
    "AND": [
      {
        "AND": [
          {
            "values": [
              {
                "value": "85dcc783-6afd-4871-9ad6-637abb29841b"
              },
              {
                "value": "0c6fa051-c4f8-4a1d-9636-7da661e11c97"
              }
            ],
            "attribute": "userId",
            "operator": "IS",
            "fieldType": "regular"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "AND": [
          {
            "values": [
              {
                "value": "abc"
              }
            ],
            "attribute": "firstName",
            "operator": "CONTAINS",
            "fieldType": "regular"
          },
          {
            "values": [
              {
                "value": "Cena"
              }
            ],
            "attribute": "lastName",
            "operator": "STARTS_WITH",
            "fieldType": "regular"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "sourceType": "app_managed",
  "parentId": "39437d92-9be0-4a25-8543-55bdab74df4e"
} ```

**Example 3: Start Date with BEFORE/ON_OR_BEFORE and Is Manager with IS (with OR condition)**
``` {
  "name": "Audience with date and manager filters",
  "type": "mixed",
  "rule": {
    "AND": [
      {
        "AND": [
          {
            "values": [
              {
                "label": "date",
                "value": "2025-11-07"
              }
            ],
            "attribute": "startDate",
            "operator": "BEFORE",
            "fieldType": "regular"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "OR": [
          {
            "values": [
              {
                "value": "True"
              }
            ],
            "attribute": "isManager",
            "operator": "IS",
            "fieldType": "regular"
          },
          {
            "values": [
              {
                "label": "date",
                "value": "2026-11-19"
              }
            ],
            "attribute": "startDate",
            "operator": "ON_OR_BEFORE",
            "fieldType": "regular"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "sourceType": "app_managed",
  "categoryId": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
} ```

**Example 4: City and Country Name with various operators**

          {

              {
                "value": "India"
              }
            ],
            "attribute": "country",
            "operator": "IS",
            "fieldType": "regular"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "sourceType": "app_managed",
  "categoryName": "Marketing Team"
} ```

              "fieldType": "regular"

            {
              "values": [

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
Request Body schema: application/json
name
required
string [ 1 .. 100 ] characters

Name of the audience

type
required
string
Value: "mixed"

Type of audience

description
string or null

Description of the audience

required
object (audience_rule_schema)

Audience rule configuration with flexible AND/OR structure

parentId
string or null

Audience category ID.

This is valid for only ABAC enabled tenants. For non-ABAC tenants, if you pass anything here it will throw error.

when you pass parentId in request audience create inside an existing audience. And newly created audience become child of parent audience provied in request.

categoryName
string or null

Audience category name.

This is valid for only ABAC enabled tenants. For non-ABAC tenants, if you pass anything here it will throw error.

When you pass categoryName in request audience create inside that category.

If audience category with the same name does not exists, we will create one with the name

categoryId
string or null <uuid>

Audience category ID.

This is valid for only ABAC enabled tenants. For non-ABAC tenants, if you pass anything here it will throw error.

when you pass categoryId in request audience create inside that category.

sourceType
string or null
Value: "app_managed"

Source type of the audience

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/identity/audiences
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/identity/audiences

Update an existing audience

This API allows you to update an existing audience

Note:

The Update Audience request does not support the parentId field.

Please refer to the Create Audience documentation for detailed guidance.

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
path Parameters
audienceId
required
string <uuid>
Example: 39437d92-9be0-4a25-8543-55bdab74df4e

The ID of the audience to update

Request Body schema: application/json
name
required
string non-empty

Name of the audience

type
required
string
Value: "mixed"

Type of audience

description
string or null

Description of the audience

required
object (audience_rule_schema)

Audience rule configuration with flexible AND/OR structure

categoryName
string or null

Audience category name.

This is valid for only ABAC enabled tenants. For non-ABAC tenants, if you pass anything here it will throw error.

When we need to move audience inside an existing category or new category.

When you pass categoryName in request audience and its children move inside that category if category with same name already exist otherwise will create new category first and move audience inside it.

We can only move hierarchy level 1 audience using this field.

categoryId
string <uuid>

Audience category ID.

This is valid for only ABAC enabled tenants. For non-ABAC tenants, if you pass anything here it will throw error.

When you pass categoryId in request audience and its children move inside that category.

We can only move hierarchy level 1 audience using this field.

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/identity/audiences/{audienceId}
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/identity/audiences/{audienceId}

Audience Members

Everything about Audience Members

Get audience members

This API allows you to retrieve a list of all members for a specific audience.

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
path Parameters
audienceId
required
string
Example: 9a736d37-4337-4f77-b177-deb3efcfd190

The unique identifier of the audience

query Parameters
pageSize
integer
Default: 10

The number of audience members to return per page.

pageToken
string

Should be what is returned as nextPageToken from a previous page request if passed.

includeTotal
boolean
Default: false

Whether to include the total number of members in the response. To include set it to true

searchTerm
string
Example: searchTerm=john

Search term to filter audience members by name

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/identity/audiences/{audienceId}/members
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/identity/audiences/{audienceId}/members

Response samples

  • 200
  • 400
  • 401
  • 403
Content type
application/json
{
  • "result": {
    • "total": 25,

Content

Everything about Content

Get contents

This API allows us to obtain list of content based on various filters

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
query Parameters
modifiedAfter
string <date-time>

Filter content modified after this date-time. Must be in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g. 2025-04-09T18:30:00.000Z)

includeDeleted
boolean
Default: false
Example: includeDeleted=false

Include deleted records in the response

includeContentFromDeactivatedSites
boolean
Default: false
Example: includeContentFromDeactivatedSites=false

Include content from deactivated sites in the response

topicId
string <uuid>

Filter content by topic ID. Required when filter is set to "topic"

filter
string
Enum: "latest" "popular" "featured" "topic"

Filter criteria for content. When set to "topic", topicId parameter is required

status
string
Default: "published"
Enum: "all" "published"

Status of content to filter. Use 'all' to fetch content with any status

size
integer [ 1 .. 50 ]
Default: 16

Number of items to return per page

siteId
string <uuid>

Optional site ID to filter the results

contentIds
string
Example: contentIds=55ec49b0-61a0-4162-9853-fd45ab2164fa,5c3af8ae-f856-4654-a990-4b46284526fe

Filter content by specific content IDs (comma-separated UUIDs)

sortBy
string
Enum: "popularity" "createdNewest" "createdOldest" "publishedNewest" "publishedOldest" "modifiedNewest" "modifiedOldest" "eventOldest" "eventNewest" "eventStartOldest"

Sort criteria for content

type
string
Enum: "page" "album" "event"

Content type filter

contentSubType
string
Enum: "news" "knowledge"

Content sub-type filter

timePeriodInDays
integer >= 0

Filter content published within specified time period in days

publishStartDateSpan
string
Enum: "past_year" "past_month" "past_week" "past_24_hours"

Filter content by publish date span

pageCategoryId
string <uuid>

Filter pages by category ID (only applicable for page content type)

peopleId
string <uuid>

Filter content by author ID

contributionId
string <uuid>

Filter content contributed by this user ID (authored or modified by this user)

isMustRead
boolean
Default: false
Example: isMustRead=false

Whether the content is must read or not

nextPageToken
integer

Token for fetching the next page of results

reportType
string
Value: "content_author_report_generation"

Specifies which bulk operation report to generate. Use 'content_author_report_generation' for author change CSV export.

requestedBy
string <uuid>
Example: requestedBy=e0853f94-c46d-41ca-89e1-5550a3638490

ID of the user who requested the bulk operation (required when reportType is provided)

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/content/sites/contents
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/content/sites/contents

Add a page to a site

This API allows us to add a page to a site

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
path Parameters
siteId
required
string
Example: eb4a3545-05f7-46e8-b17d-107339b6aae6

The ID of the site to add a page to

query Parameters
action
required
string
Enum: "publish" "saveDraft"
Example: action=publish

The action to perform on the page

Request Body schema: application/json
contentSubType
required
string
Enum: "news" "knowledge"

Type of content being created

Array of Intranet File (object) or Google Drive File (object) or Box File (object) or OneDrive File (object) or SharePoint File (object) or Dropbox File (object) (file)

Array of file attachments

publishAt
string <date-time>

Date and time when the content should be published (required when publishingStatus is 'schedule'). Must be in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g. 2025-04-09T18:30:00.000Z)

publishTo
string or null <date-time>

Date and time when the content should expire/unpublish. Must be in ISO 8601 UTC format

bodyHtml
required
string

Main content of the page in HTML format

publishingStatus
required
string
Enum: "immediate" "schedule"

Publishing status of the content

imgLayout
string
Enum: "small" "fullscreen" "hidden" "wide"

Layout style for the featured image

imgCaption
string or null <= 255 characters

Caption for the featured image

imgLandscapeFile
string or null <uuid>

UUID of the landscape image file

imgFile
string or null <uuid>

UUID of the main image file

imgOriginalFile
string or null <uuid>

UUID of the original image file

imgLandscape
string or null

URL of the landscape image

title
required
string <= 255 characters

Title of the page

isMaximumWidth
boolean

Whether to use maximum width layout

isFeedEnabled
boolean

Whether the page appears in feeds

isQuestionAnswerEnabled
boolean

Whether question and answer feature is enabled

Array of objects or null

Array of topics associated with the page

required
object

Category information for the page

summary
string or null <= 10000 characters

Summary of the page content

language
string

Language of the content

manualTransEnabled
boolean

Whether manual translation is enabled

createdBy
required
string <uuid>

UUID of the user creating the page

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/content/sites/{siteId}/page
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/content/sites/{siteId}/page

Get feeds

This API allows you to retrieve all feeds

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
query Parameters
nextPageToken
required
string
Example: nextPageToken=1759911721822

Token for pagination.

  • For initial request, send empty string ""
  • For subsequent requests, use the nextPageToken returned as integer from previous response
size
required
string
Example: size=16

The number of feeds to return per page

sortBy
string
Default: "createdAt"
Enum: "createdAt" "lastActivityAt"
filter
string
Default: "all"
Value: "all"

The filter to apply to the feeds

feedContext
string
Default: "home"
Enum: "home" "site" "content"

The context of the feeds.

  • When set to "site", siteId parameter is required
  • When set to "content", both siteId and contentId parameters are required
type
string
Enum: "post" "question"
Example: type=post

The type of feed to return

siteId
string
Example: siteId=a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890

The ID of the site. Required when feedContext is "site" or "content"

contentId
string
Example: contentId=a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890

The ID of the content. Required when feedContext is "content"

feedIds
string
Example: feedIds=97576a5d-4362-40cb-b8ac-5418b64bf84f,6d54cb3d-da29-461b-8019-3dfb8aa8afe2

The IDs of the feeds to return (send comma-separated list of feed IDs without spaces)

exemptFeedIds
string
Example: exemptFeedIds=97576a5d-4362-40cb-b8ac-5418b64bf84f,6d54cb3d-da29-461b-8019-3dfb8aa8afe2

The IDs of the feeds to exempt from the search (send comma-separated list of feed IDs without spaces)

isSearchForMarkDuplicate
boolean
Example: isSearchForMarkDuplicate=false

Whether to search for mark duplicate feeds(questions)

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/rfeed/feeds

Add or remove a reaction to a feed

This API allows you to add or remove a reaction (like, emoji) to a feed post

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
path Parameters
feedId
required
string <uuid>
Example: eb4a3545-05f7-46e8-b17d-107339b6aae6

The ID of the feed to add/remove reaction

Request Body schema: application/json
action
required
string
Enum: "add" "remove"

The action to perform - add or remove a reaction

reactionType
required
string
Enum: "like" "emoji/1F44D" "emoji/2764" "emoji/1F606" "emoji/1F4A1" "emoji/1F64F" "emoji/1F44F" "emoji/2B06"

The type of reaction to add or remove.

  • like: Standard like
  • emoji/1F44D: Thumbs up 👍
  • emoji/2764: Love ❤️
  • emoji/1F606: Haha 😆
  • emoji/1F4A1: Insightful 💡
  • emoji/1F64F: Pray 🙏
  • emoji/1F44F: Clapping 👏
  • emoji/2B06: Upvote ⬆️ (only applicable for question feeds)
createdBy
required
string <uuid>

Files

Everything about Files

Get a presigned URL to upload a file to Simpplr

This API allows us to get a presigned URL for uploading files to Simpplr. Few points to note:

  • The upload_url(presigned URL) in the response should be used with PUT method to upload the file.
  • The presigned URL should be invoked with same Bearer token as this API.
  • The file_id should be saved for linking with entities via other APIs.
Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
Request Body schema: application/json
file_name
required
string [ 1 .. 500 ] characters

Name of the file to be uploaded

size
required
integer >= 1

Size of the file in bytes

createdBy
required
string <uuid>

UUID of the user to be associated with the file upload

alt_text
string [ 0 .. 500 ] characters

Alt text for the file

mime_type
string [ 0 .. 100 ] characters

MIME type of the file

type
string or null
Enum: "bulk-ops" "content"

Type of file being uploaded

uploadContext
string or null
Default: null
Enum: "site-feed" "content-attachment" "site-files" "home-feed" "tiles"

Context in which the file is being uploaded

siteId
string <uuid>

UUID of the site where the file is being uploaded

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/content/static/signedurl/upload
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/content/static/signedurl/upload

Recognition

Everything about Recognition

Get recognition list

Retrieve recognition list data with optional filtering and pagination. The response will be paginated and sorted by creation date in descending order(newest first).

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
Request Body schema: application/json
optional

Get recognition list

award
Array of strings

Award names to filter by, each award name must be 100 characters or less.

department
Array of strings

Departments to filter by, matches departments of giver or recipient department.

object or string

Duration filter for recognition creation date.

Array of objects[ items non-empty ]

Locations to filter by, matches locations of giver or recipient location.

pageToken
string

A cursor to use in pagination, must be a non-negative number as string.

pageSize
integer

Number of items per page (1-100, default 10).

type
Array of strings
Items Enum: "NOMINATION" "DIRECT" "PEER" "SPOT" "MILESTONE"

Award types to filter by.

customField
Array of strings

Custom field ending with __c, must be an array of strings.

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/recognition/list
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/recognition/list

Sites

Get sites

This API allows us to obtain list of sites based on various filters

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
query Parameters
size
integer [ 1 .. 1000 ]
Default: 50

Maximum number of results to return

nextPageToken
integer

Token for fetching the next page of results

filter
string [ 1 .. 200 ] characters
Value: "featured"

Optional filter for results

sortBy
string [ 1 .. 255 ] characters
Default: "alphabetical"
Enum: "alphabetical" "featured" "createdNewest" "popular" "updatedNewest"

Technique for sorting results

siteIds
Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]

Optional list of site UUIDs to filter the results

modifiedAfter
string <date-time>

Only return results modified after this date-time. Must be in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g. 2025-04-09T18:30:00.000Z)

includeDeactivated
boolean
Default: false

Whether to include deactivated sites or not

Users

Everything about Users

Get Users

This API allows you to get all users of a tenant.

Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
query Parameters
pageSize
integer
Default: 50

The number of users to return per page.

pageToken
string

Should be a integer returned as nextPageToken from previous page request

parseCustomFields
string
Default: "false"
Enum: "true" "false"

Whether to parse custom fields (if custom field types enabled)

includeTotal
boolean
Default: false

Whether to include the total number of users in the response. To include set it to true

string or string
Default: "minimal"

Comma separated list of fields to include in the response. use all to include all fields use minimal to include only the login identifiers use comma separated field names to include specific fields Ex: firstName,lastName,etc

modifiedAfter
string <date-time>
Example: modifiedAfter=2025-04-09T18:30:00.000Z

Filter users modified after this date-time. Must be in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g. 2025-04-09T18:30:00.000Z)

sortBy
string
Example: sortBy=firstName:ASC,lastName:DSC

Field to sort the users by value can be csv Ex: firstName:ASC,lastName:DSC

employeeNumber
string
Example: employeeNumber=E123

filter users by employee number

firstName
string
Example: firstName=John

filter users by first name

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/identity/users
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/identity/users

Upload files for users

This API allows generation of upload URL for user photos and cover images. To set the photo on a user object,

  • Do a PUT to the response URL with image data returned.
  • The URL is valid for 5 minutes.
  • Call user update API (preferably PATCH) to set the photoFileId and coverImageId to the file IDs returned in this API response.

Example request:

{
  "useFor": "photo",
  "userId": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",
  "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
  "size": 1024000
}
Authorizations:
OAuth2ClientCredentials
Request Body schema: application/json
useFor
required
string
Enum: "photo" "coverImage"

Purpose of the file upload:

  • photo: User profile photo (recommended: square images, preferably 200px x 200px)
  • coverImage: User cover image (recommended: 746px x 304px)
userId
required
string <uuid>

UUID of the user for whom the file is being uploaded

mimeType
required
string

MIME type of the file to be uploaded. Supported formats:

  • image/png
  • image/jpg
  • image/jpeg
  • image/gif
size
required
number [ 1 .. 4194304 ]

Size of the file in bytes.

  • photo limit: 2097152 (2MB)
  • coverImage limit: 4194304 (4MB)

Responses

https://platform.{env}.simpplr.xyz/v1/b2b/identity/users/files
https://platform.{env}.simpplr.com/v1/b2b/identity/users/files

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "useFor": "photo",
  • "userId": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",
  • "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
  • "size": 1024000
}

Response samples

  • 400

  • "status": "success",
  • "result": {
    • "fileId": "27275ee6-d56f-4e52-bc40-a44229d83c86",
    • "uploadUrl": "https://fe-domain/u/o/277b3c02-c912-4c45-8512-867d92e47b84?Content-Type=image%2Fjpeg&X-Amz-Algorithm=........."
    }
}
